text:
Ava: Taking a redeye tomorrow and trying to be a polite sobber. Need: one tiny book (can finish on the plane) that will gut me, and one single-track heartbreak song that won't make my neighbor throw a look. Hit me.
Marco: For a plane-sized gut-punch book: 'The Sense of an Ending' is short but sticks. Single-track: 'Holocene' (Bon Iver) is reliably devastating yet quiet.
Priya: Seconding Sense of an Ending. Also 'The Ocean at the End of the Lane' if you want something a little more magical and melancholy. Single-track option: Sufjan Stevens 'Fourth of July' 10/10 whisper-cry.
Ethan: If you want a modern micro-memoir try 'On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous' (it's chunkier but you can skim a section). For one-track tears: 'The Night We Met' (Lord Huron) is stealthy.
Sara: If you like slightly eerie instead of straight sadness, 'We Have Always Lived in the Castle' (Jackson) is short and sticky. Also audiobooks are great if you want to nap and still be emotionally wrecked on arrival.
Ava: Love these. Any recs for a single instrumental that hits hard (no lyrics so it's less obvious on a plane)?
Marco: Max Richter 'On The Nature Of Daylight' 100% airplane-appropriate. Minimal, orchestral, will clandestinely shatter you.
Priya: Agnes Obel 'Riverside' is another calm instrumental-ish vibe.
Ethan: I made a micro playlist called 'redeye-soft-cry' with 8 tracks: Bon Iver, Sufjan, Max Richter, Agnes Obel, Lord Huron, Josh Ritter. Want the share link?
Ava: Yes please. Also: paperback or audiobook? I want to actually feel the words, not just be led by a narrator.
Sara: Paperback if you want to underline lines and re-read. Audiobook if you want to nap and wake up at tears. I prefer paperback on flights with good lights; otherwise audiobook.
ops-bot: FYI Ava 10: Gate update for flight RWI237 10: now departing from B12, boarding 04:30.
Ethan: Here's a quick copy-paste snippet of the playlist if you want to build it manually:
```
1. Bon Iver 1 Holocene
2. Max Richter 1 On The Nature Of Daylight
3. Sufjan Stevens 1 Fourth of July
4. Agnes Obel 1 Riverside
5. Lord Huron 1 The Night We Met
6. Josh Ritter 1 The Curse
7. Keaton Henson 1 You
8. The Cinematic Orchestra 1 To Build A Home
```
Ava: Perfect. Thanks y'all. Will report back from 30,000ft with tissue stains. :tissue_box: :airplane:
